Miqaat is a prayer clock. It calculates the five daily prayer times on this device for the place you choose, plays the azaan, and can count down to iqamah for prayer at home.  Nothing is uploaded: there is no account, no advertising and no analytics. Two things use the network — the optional place-name lookup (Android's geocoder, run by Google) and the update check on GitHub in the direct-download edition. Both are off until you use them.
Setup takes about a minute: your place → check the times → azaan alerts.

اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ

name: dua-hadith-t67
labels: Dua after azaan → hadith → back to the clock, with narration
A HADITH AFTER DHUHR · ṢAḤĪḤ AL-BUKHĀRĪ 2989 · ṢAḤĪḤ MUSLIM 1009

قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: كُلُّ سُلاَمَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَطْلُعُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ، يَعْدِلُ بَيْنَ الاِثْنَيْنِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَيُعِينُ الرَّجُلَ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every joint of a person owes a charity each day the sun rises: to judge justly between two people is charity, to help a man onto his mount is charity, and a good word is charity.”
Narrated by Abū Hurayrah  ·  Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 2989 · Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1009

A HADITH AFTER DHUHR · ṢAḤĪḤ AL-BUKHĀRĪ 5971 · ṢAḤĪḤ MUSLIM 2548
مَنْ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي؟ قَالَ: أُمُّكَ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: أُمُّكَ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: أُمُّكَ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ
